title: FC Format v4 Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Free Fire Craftland Code (FC) formatter v4.

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for editor autocompletion.

printWidth.description: Target maximum line width in characters for automatic wrapping.

tabWidth.description: Visual character width of one indentation level.

useTabs.description: Whether to indent with tab characters instead of spaces.

endOfLine.description: Line ending convention. 'auto' detects and preserves existing file line endings, 'lf' enforces Unix newlines (\n), 'crlf' enforces Windows newlines (\r\n).

spaceAroundOperators.description: Whether to insert spaces around binary operators (e.g. `a + b` vs `a+b`).

spaceAfterComma.description: Whether to insert a space after commas in argument and collection lists.

alignCompositeSeparators.description: Whether to column-align colons (`:`) in Map literals and equals signs (`=`) in Struct literals across multiline entries. Set to false for standard Prettier/Google diff-friendly layout.

bracketSpacing.description: Whether to insert spaces inside single-line composite braces (e.g. `Vector3{ 0, 0, 0 }` vs `Vector3{0, 0, 0}`).

wrapCalls.description: Wrapping strategy for function call arguments and parameter lists.

wrapCollections.description: Wrapping strategy for composite literals (List, Map, Struct, Tuple).

collapseBlankLines.description: Whether to collapse consecutive empty lines down to a single empty line.

maxBlankLines.description: Maximum consecutive blank lines to preserve.

insertFinalNewline.description: Ensure files end with a trailing newline character.

sortImports.description: Whether to automatically sort and group file-header imports (Standard Library, Contracts, Relative).
